text: Planning a trip is always exciting, whether it’s a weekend getaway or a month-long adventure. Before I travel, I usually research local customs and must-see sights, which helps me feel prepared. Once I arrive, however, the real magic begins. Trying new foods is one of my favorite parts, even when I cannot pronounce the dish names correctly. Language barriers can be challenging, but using hand gestures and a translation app often leads to funny, unforgettable moments. In the end, it is not the perfect itinerary that stays with me—it is the warm smiles, the unexpected detours, and the stories I share with friends back home. These experiences become the memories I treasure most.
